regime.label: Dealer long-gamma dampening band 1040-1090 over a max pain frozen at 1050, with a short-gamma trapdoor below 1040
evidence: +4,339 baht/pt net dealer gamma across 1040-1080 (+851 at the 1060 ATM alone) - calls outweigh puts 5,615 to 3,450 contracts in that band, so hedging flow fades moves inside it.

1050 carries 2,577 contracts of OI on 436 contracts of volume today - the most active strike on the board and a live wall by the Vol2Vol filter, while the headline 960 put wall (1,960 OI) traded only 29 lots 102.3 points away and is stale structure, not active burden.
-5,256 baht/pt cumulative GEX at 1040 is the trapdoor: below it dealers flip to short gamma and hedge with the move, so the pin is one-sided - damped above 1040, amplifying beneath it.
11.17% ATM IV puts the 1-sigma day at 7.48 points (0.70%), and max pain has not moved off 1050 in any of the last 8 sessions despite the anchor travelling +17.7 points.

S50Z26.today_summary: 1062.3 on the Dec future, -3.6 on the session, sits 12.3 points above a max pain that has been frozen at 1050 for eight straight sessions. 0.93 P/C OI is the first call-heavy reading of the month - call OI 11,900 against put OI 11,112 - and 0.76 P/C volume says today's flow leaned call-side too. The 25d skew is inverted at -1.08 (1020 put 11.27% vs 1090 call 12.36%), so the burden being bought here is upside participation, not downside insurance. 11.17% ATM IV caps the 1-sigma day at 7.48 points, which is why the 1040-1090 band is holding.
what_changed: Call wall migrated 1100 -> 1050 as 1050 call OI built +248 in a session and +307 over five, taking the single largest call line to 1,746 contracts on 327 lots of volume.
P/C OI ratio fell 1.05 -> 0.93 over five sessions - call OI +1,040 while put OI shed 268, the first time calls have outweighed puts in this window.
Gamma flip re-formed and tightened: no positive crossing at all on 10-22 and 10-23, then 1100 on 10-27, now 1090 - dealers have reclaimed positive cumulative gamma 27.7 points above spot.
Near-money put burden rolled down and away - 1060 put OI -242 and 1100 put OI -73 over five sessions, while 1010 built +139 and 970 built +105.
S50Z26.five_day_thesis: The anchor has travelled +17.7 points since 10-22 (1044.6 -> 1062.3) while max pain never left 1050, so price has levered itself 12.3 points clear of the structure rather than the structure following price. What repriced is the burden map: the entire 1050-1150 call strip built (+307 at 1050, +275 at 1070, +205 at 1090, +257 at 1100) while puts rolled down from 1060 (-242) into 1010 and 970, which is a market shedding near-money protection as it drifts up. That rebuild flipped the cumulative GEX profile from wholly negative on 10-22 and 10-23 to a crossing at 1090 today - dealers went from chasing every move to fading moves inside 1040-1090. IV compressed alongside it, 11.61% to 11.17%, with the 10-27 print of 10.78% the five-day floor, so the dampening is being paid for with a smaller expected range. The one unresolved tension is the eight-session max-pain freeze at 1050: either the 1050 line keeps acting as the magnet it has been all month, or the +13.6-point session on 10-27 was the start of real flow beating the option structure - and the 1040 short-gamma trapdoor is where that question gets answered.

strategies.name: Iron condor 1000P / 1020P x 1100C / 1120C
strategies.rationale: Both short strikes sit on the 25d delta bands (1020 put, 1090 call) and outside the +4,339 baht/pt long-gamma band, so dealer hedging works against any excursion toward the wings while 11.17% IV keeps the 1-sigma day at 7.48 points over 61 sessions.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 20-point wing width minus net credit received, and only one side can finish in the money.
strategies.invalidation: A close below 1040 (cumulative GEX -5,256 baht/pt, dealers turn trend-amplifying) or above 1100 (1,735-contract near-money call wall).

strategies.name: Put credit spread 1030P / 1010P
strategies.rationale: 1030 sits 32.3 points below spot and above the live 1020 put block (1,019 OI on 109 lots), harvesting the lower half of the long-gamma band while the shedding of 1060 puts (-242 over five sessions) and the -1.08 call-rich skew say the downside bid is thinning.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 20 points minus net credit received.
strategies.invalidation: A close below 1040 - that is the long-gamma band's floor, not the 1030 strike, so the warning precedes the loss.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1020P / 990P
strategies.rationale: The 1020 put prints 11.27% IV against 11.17% ATM, so the surface charges almost nothing for the convexity sitting right above a -5,256 baht/pt short-gamma pocket - the one place on this board where dealer hedging would add to a move rather than absorb it.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = the net debit paid; maximum spread value 30 points.
strategies.invalidation: A sustained hold above 1080, or any reclaim of the 1090 gamma flip, which puts dealers firmly long gamma and drains the tail.

S50Z26.prediction: 1040-1090 is the base-case band for the next five sessions: +4,339 baht/pt of near-money dealer gamma plus a 7.48-point 1-sigma day argues most sessions realise less than their implied range, with 1050 still the magnet it has been for eight straight sessions. A close below 1040 is the level that breaks this read - cumulative GEX is -5,256 baht/pt there and dealers would hedge with the move, so the first 10 points through it should travel faster than the 1-sigma estimate. On the other side, 1100 and its 1,735-contract call wall caps the drift; 1090 is already positive-gamma territory, so an upside break should grind rather than squeeze.
S50Z26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and none of these structures is a recommendation to execute. Defined-risk is not risk-free: the 20-point wings are real maximum losses and short-vol payoffs carry negative skew (frequent small gains, rare large losses), so the 1040 trapdoor matters more than its probability suggests. SET50 options are European and cash-settled on the SET50 index, so there is no physical delivery to force hedging into a strike - pinning toward 1050 is a tendency, structurally weaker than for share-settled single stocks, and at 61 DTE it is a slow magnet rather than an expiry pin. Watch for max-pain failure: the anchor has already held 12.3 points above 1050 for several sessions, and if a move away from 1050 comes with expanding volume and rising IV, the real flow is beating the option structure and mean-reversion should not be assumed. All figures are from the 2026-10-29 03:51 +07:00 scrape of a single active series (S50Z26); the 960 put wall is stale structure (29 lots, 102.3 points away) and should not be weighted as live support.
